text: シルフ　カンパニー　のっとったら　せかい　じゅうに　ポケモン　うって　ガバガバ　おお　もうけ　だぜ！

structure.jp: シルフ　カンパニー　のっとったら
structure.en: once we take over Silph Co.

structure.jp: せかい　じゅうに　ポケモン　うって
structure.en: we'll sell Pokémon all over the world and

structure.jp: ガバガバ　おお　もうけ　だぜ！
structure.en: it's a huge profit pouring in!

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'once' or 'if' that has happened. のっとったら = 'once we've taken it over'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. ポケモン　うって = 'sell Pokémon, and'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, tough-guy way of stressing what you say. おお　もうけ　だぜ = 'it's a fortune, I tell you!'
